title: Carnegie Mellon University Announces Historic $3B Gift from Ken Griffin
title_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学宣布 Historic $3B 礼金从 Ken Griffin

paragraphs.en: Conceptual rendering. Plans for the CMU Miami campus are subject to necessary regulatory approvals. September 30, 2026 Carnegie Mellon University Announces Historic $3 Billion Gift from Ken Griffin, Pioneering a New Model for Higher Education Share on Facebook (opens in new window) Share on X (opens in new window) Share on LinkedIn (opens in new window) Print this page Share by email Media Inquiries Name Media Relations Title University Communications & Marketing Email Largest Individual Gift in Higher Education History Builds on CMU’s Distinctive Academic and Research Strengths, Includes $1 Billion Investment in Pittsburgh Campus $2 Billion Gift Will Launch CMU Miami, Organized Around Societal Challenges and Purpose-Built for Next Era of American Innovation 35-Acre Campus in Miami’s Wynwood Neighborhood Aims to Start Enrolling Students in 2028 Carnegie Mellon University (CMU) and Citadel founder and CEO Ken Griffin (opens in new window) today announced a historic $3 billion gift to further elevate CMU in Pittsburgh and launch Carnegie Mellon University Miami , a new campus designed to pioneer a model for higher education built for the next era of American innovation. CMU Miami will be a new campus organized around societal challenges, designed to prepare future leaders for a rapidly changing world while accelerating research and discovery in areas of critical importance to society.

sents.en: CMU Miami will be a new campus organized around societal challenges, designed to prepare future leaders for a rapidly changing world while accelerating research and discovery in areas of critical importance to society.
sents.zh: 卡内基梅隆大学迈阿密校区将是一个围绕社会挑战而组建的新校区，旨在培养适应快速变化世界的未来领导者，同时加速在对社会至关重要的领域的研究与发现。

paragraphs.en: Throughout its history, CMU has established a compelling advantage: deep expertise in advanced computing, robotics, and machine learning, grounded in foundational sciences, interdisciplinary innovation, and a strong humanistic core. Together, these strengths allow CMU to move ideas across disciplines and translate discovery into technologies and solutions that improve lives, strengthen industries and advance American competitiveness.
paragraphs.zh: 纵观其历史，卡内基梅隆大学已建立起显著优势：在先进计算、机器人技术和机器学习领域的深厚专业积淀，并植根于基础科学、跨学科创新和深厚的人文底蕴。 这些优势共同使卡内基梅隆大学能够跨越学科推动思想流动，将科学发现转化为改善生活、强化产业并提升美国竞争力的技术与解决方案。

sents.en: Throughout its history, CMU has established a compelling advantage: deep expertise in advanced computing, robotics, and machine learning, grounded in foundational sciences, interdisciplinary innovation, and a strong humanistic core.

sents.en: Together, these strengths allow CMU to move ideas across disciplines and translate discovery into technologies and solutions that improve lives, strengthen industries and advance American competitiveness.

paragraphs.en: CMU’s leadership in higher education is defined by a willingness to make strategic investments ahead of their time. CMU established the world’s first drama program , robotics institute , human-computer interaction institute and department of engineering and public policy , as well as the nation’s first computer science college. That leadership translates into exceptional outcomes for students: Carnegie Mellon ranks No. 3 nationally in graduate earnings by academic major in the 2027 U.S. News & World Report Best Colleges rankings. The university also ranks No. 1 in undergraduate computer science and among the top five in 17 undergraduate specialty categories.
paragraphs.zh: 卡内基梅隆大学（CMU）在高等教育领域的领导地位，源于其愿意在时代之前进行战略性投资的魄力。 CMU 创立了全球首个戏剧项目、机器人研究所、人机交互研究所以及工程与公共政策系，并建立了全美首个计算机科学学院。 这种领导地位为学生带来了卓越的成果：在 2027 年《美国新闻与世界报道》最佳院校排名中，卡内基梅隆大学在全美各专业毕业生收入排名中位列第 3。 该排名由《美国新闻与世界报道》最佳院校排名发布。 该校的本科计算机科学专业排名第 1，并在 17 个本科专业类别中跻身前五。

paragraphs.en: Griffin’s $3 billion gift will consist of $1 billion to support CMU’s Pittsburgh campus, split evenly between flexible support for the university’s highest priorities and a $500 million investment in its top-ranked School of Computer Science , which will be renamed the Kenneth C. Griffin School of Computer Science. An additional $2 billion will support the launch of CMU Miami.
paragraphs.zh: 格里芬的30亿美元捐赠中，将有10亿美元用于支持卡内基梅隆大学匹兹堡校区，均分为大学最高优先事项的灵活支持资金，以及对该校排名第一的计算机科学学院5亿美元的投资，该学院将更名为肯尼斯·C. 格里芬计算机科学学院。 另外的20亿美元将用于支持卡内基梅隆大学迈阿密校区的启动。

sents.zh: 另外的20亿美元将用于支持卡内基梅隆大学迈阿密校区的启动。

paragraphs.en: Together, these investments reflect Griffin’s belief in Carnegie Mellon’s ability to attract exceptional talent, advance transformative research and prepare graduates to solve consequential problems and lead with impact. Griffin will also join Carnegie Mellon’s Board of Trustees , further solidifying his dedication to the university.
paragraphs.zh: 这些投资共同体现了格里芬对卡内基梅隆大学的一种信念：这所大学能够吸引杰出人才，推进变革性研究，并培养毕业生去解决重大问题、发挥有影响力的领导作用。 格里芬还将加入卡内基梅隆大学董事会，进一步巩固他对这所大学的奉献精神。

sents.en: Together, these investments reflect Griffin’s belief in Carnegie Mellon’s ability to attract exceptional talent, advance transformative research and prepare graduates to solve consequential problems and lead with impact.

sents.en: Griffin will also join Carnegie Mellon’s Board of Trustees , further solidifying his dedication to the university.
sents.zh: 格里芬还将加入卡内基梅隆大学董事会，进一步巩固他对这所大学的奉献精神。

paragraphs.en: CMU Miami will invert the traditional higher education model by organizing learning and inquiry around societal challenges rather than academic majors. It will be entirely designed and built — from first blueprints to final beam — to drive revolutionary breakthroughs that address society’s defining challenges.
paragraphs.zh: CMU Miami 将颠覆传统的高等教育模式，围绕社会挑战而非学术专业来组织学习与探究。 它将完全从设计到建造——从第一张蓝图到最后一根横梁——都旨在推动革命性突破，以应对社会所面临的重大挑战。

sents.zh: CMU Miami 将颠覆传统的高等教育模式，围绕社会挑战而非学术专业来组织学习与探究。

sents.en: It will be entirely designed and built — from first blueprints to final beam — to drive revolutionary breakthroughs that address society’s defining challenges.
sents.zh: 它将完全从设计到建造——从第一张蓝图到最后一根横梁——都旨在推动革命性突破，以应对社会所面临的重大挑战。

paragraphs.en: At launch, CMU Miami will focus on grand challenge areas spanning human health and biological discovery; national security and strategic capabilities; energy and climate resilience; and advanced manufacturing and industrial transformation. The campus will also serve as a platform for curricular innovation, new approaches to teaching and hands-on learning.
paragraphs.zh: 在启动阶段，卡内基梅隆大学迈阿密校区将聚焦于若干重大挑战领域，涵盖人类健康与生物发现、国家安全与战略能力、能源与气候韧性，以及先进制造与产业转型。 该校区还将作为课程创新、新教学方法以及实践动手学习的平台。

sents.zh: 在启动阶段，卡内基梅隆大学迈阿密校区将聚焦于若干重大挑战领域，涵盖人类健康与生物发现、国家安全与战略能力、能源与气候韧性，以及先进制造与产业转型。

sents.en: The campus will also serve as a platform for curricular innovation, new approaches to teaching and hands-on learning.
sents.zh: 该校区还将作为课程创新、新教学方法以及实践动手学习的平台。

paragraphs.en: Interdisciplinary teams of students, researchers, industry leaders and government partners will put CMU’s competitive advantages to work in addressing these grand challenges. They will draw on the full breadth of CMU, with humanities, arts and design playing an essential role in bringing creativity, context and a deep understanding of the human experience. The goal is to prepare graduates to lead with confidence and make meaningful contributions earlier in their careers.
paragraphs.zh: 由学生、研究人员、行业领袖和政府合作伙伴组成的跨学科团队将发挥卡内基梅隆大学的竞争优势，应对这些重大挑战。 他们将依托卡内基梅隆大学的全部学科广度，其中人文学科、艺术与设计将在带来创造力、背景视野以及对人类体验的深刻理解方面发挥关键作用。 目标是让毕业生能够满怀信心地发挥领导作用，并在职业生涯的早期阶段做出有意义的贡献。

paragraphs.en: CMU Miami is designed to move beyond the traditional hub-and-spoke model of university expansion. Rather than simply extending individual programs or research activities into a new city, CMU Miami will develop into a comprehensive university campus where education and research are equally central to the mission, built to the same standards of academic excellence that define CMU.
paragraphs.zh: CMU迈阿密校区旨在突破传统的高校扩张“轴辐式”模式。 CMU迈阿密校区并非简单地将单个项目或研究活动延伸到一座新城市，而是将发展成一个教育与研究在使命中同等重要的综合性大学校区，并以界定CMU的同样卓越学术标准来建设。

sents.zh: CMU迈阿密校区旨在突破传统的高校扩张“轴辐式”模式。

sents.en: Rather than simply extending individual programs or research activities into a new city, CMU Miami will develop into a comprehensive university campus where education and research are equally central to the mission, built to the same standards of academic excellence that define CMU.
sents.zh: CMU迈阿密校区并非简单地将单个项目或研究活动延伸到一座新城市，而是将发展成一个教育与研究在使命中同等重要的综合性大学校区，并以界定CMU的同样卓越学术标准来建设。

paragraphs.en: “We are deeply grateful to Ken Griffin for his extraordinary vision, partnership and belief in what Carnegie Mellon can achieve,” said CMU President Farnam Jahanian . “Throughout our history, CMU has anticipated moments of profound technological change and responded with new ways of thinking and solving problems. Artificial intelligence represents one of the defining intellectual developments of our time, and it demands that we rethink how we educate students, conduct research and partner with others. Together, we have an opportunity to extend the very qualities that have long distinguished Carnegie Mellon — our agility, creativity, interdisciplinary culture and relentless focus on impact — to build a new model for higher education that meets the urgency of this moment.”
paragraphs.zh: “我们衷心感谢 Ken Griffin 的非凡远见、伙伴情谊以及对卡内基梅隆所能取得成就的坚定信念，”CMU 校长 Farnam Jahanian 表示。“纵观我们的历史，CMU 总能预判深刻的科技变革时刻，并以新的思考和解决问题的方式作出回应。 人工智能代表了我们这个时代最重要的智识发展之一，它要求我们重新思考如何教育学生、开展研究以及与他人合作。 我们有机会共同将卡内基梅隆长期以来与众不同的特质——我们的敏捷、创造力、跨学科文化以及对影响力的不懈追求——加以延伸，构建一个契合当下紧迫性的高等教育新模式。”

paragraphs.en: “Carnegie Mellon University has made profound contributions to America’s preeminence in science, engineering, technology, and the arts and humanities,” said Ken Griffin. “Since its founding, Carnegie Mellon has fostered remarkable talent, pioneered scientific breakthroughs, and expanded the frontiers of research — shaping global leaders and innovators.
paragraphs.zh: “卡内基梅隆大学为美国在科学、工程、技术以及艺术与人文领域的卓越地位作出了深远贡献，”肯·格里芬说。“自建校以来，卡内基梅隆大学培养了杰出人才，开创了科学突破，拓展了研究的边界——塑造了全球的领导者与创新者。

paragraphs.en: “The opportunity to bring Carnegie Mellon to Miami places our city at the heart of humanistic and scientific advancement and amplifies the University’s international reach and impact. It is a tremendous privilege to be part of this historic moment. CMU Miami represents a generational opportunity to build a new center of research and intellectual life — one that will attract exceptional students, scholars, and researchers from across the globe and rank among the world’s most important academic institutions. Building upon the University’s record of excellence in educating and inspiring the next generation, CMU Miami will cultivate the talent, knowledge, and expertise to launch new enterprises, contribute to Miami’s economy and community, and advance the prosperity of our nation.”

paragraphs.en: Once complete, the state-of-the-art campus will support more than 3,500 undergraduate, master’s and PhD students, nearly 300 faculty and over 600 staff members. Construction is slated to begin in 2027. The current plan, pending regulatory approvals, sees the first students enrolling in 2028.
paragraphs.zh: 建成后，这座先进的校园将支持超过3500名本科生、硕士生和博士生，近300名教师以及600多名职员。 工程预计于2027年动工。 根据目前计划，在获得监管审批后，首批学生将于2028年入学。

paragraphs.en: Located on more than 35 acres in Wynwood — in the heart of Miami — the campus will support a comprehensive student experience and an interdisciplinary environment designed for learning, research and collaboration. Plans include space for industry research labs and venture studios, creating opportunities for students, faculty, industry and community partners to work alongside one another. The campus itself will serve as a living laboratory for new ideas, while creating opportunities for collaboration across CMU’s locations.
paragraphs.zh: 该校区位于迈阿密市中心温伍德区，占地超过35英亩，将支持全面的学生体验，并为学习、研究和协作打造跨学科环境。 规划中包括行业研究实验室和创业工作室的空间，为学生、教师、行业和社区伙伴创造共事合作的机会。 校区本身将作为一个新想法的活实验室，同时为卡内基梅隆大学各校区之间的协作创造机会。

paragraphs.en: "Every great Carnegie Mellon story begins with partnership," Jahanian said. "Our relationship with Pittsburgh has shaped CMU for more than a century, and we believe the connections we build in Miami will enrich both cities. We look forward to listening, learning and working alongside our neighbors to create new opportunities for collaboration, innovation and shared prosperity."

paragraphs.en: Griffin’s anchor gift of $3 billion to support CMU and build CMU Miami is the largest-ever gift by an individual in the history of higher education. It is also Griffin’s largest-ever gift, reflecting the priorities of Griffin Catalyst (opens in new window) , his civic engagement initiative, which finds and funds creative solutions to drive impact at scale and transform lives.
paragraphs.zh: 格里芬向卡内基梅隆大学（CMU）捐赠30亿美元的锚定资金，用于支持CMU并建设CMU迈阿密校区，这是高等教育历史上个人捐赠数额最大的一笔礼物。 这也是格里芬迄今数额最大的一笔捐赠，体现了他旗下公民参与倡议机构Griffin Catalyst（在新窗口中打开）的优先事项，该机构致力于发掘并资助创新性解决方案，以推动规模化影响并改变人们的生活。

paragraphs.en: Carnegie Mellon University is a private, global research university founded in 1900 and headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Recognized among the world’s leading institutions and ranked No. 14 among national universities in the 2027 U.S. News & World Report Best Colleges rankings, CMU is distinguished by its academic excellence, entrepreneurial spirit and leadership at the intersection of technology, the arts, business and public policy. The university’s interdisciplinary approach spans seven colleges and schools and drives innovation across fields including artificial intelligence, computer science, engineering, robotics, cybersecurity, the performing arts, business, humanities and social science and design.
paragraphs.zh: 卡内基梅隆大学是一所私立、全球化的研究型大学，创立于1900年，总部位于宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡。 作为公认的世界一流学府，卡内基梅隆大学在2027年《美国新闻与世界报道》全美最佳大学排名中位列第14位。 卡内基梅隆大学以其卓越的学术水平、企业家精神，以及在技术、艺术、商业与公共政策交汇领域的领导地位而著称。 该校的跨学科方法涵盖七所学院，推动人工智能、计算机科学、工程学、机器人技术、网络安全、表演艺术、商业、人文与社会科学以及设计等多个领域的创新。

paragraphs.en: A university without borders, Carnegie Mellon extends its impact far beyond Pittsburgh through a global network of programs, partnerships and research initiatives spanning Europe, Africa, Asia and beyond, including campuses in Qatar and Rwanda. Its community includes students, faculty and alumni from more than 100 countries, reflecting a deeply international perspective. Carnegie Mellon’s faculty and alumni include dozens of Nobel Prize and Turing Award recipients, as well as members of prestigious academies and leaders across industry, government and the arts worldwide.
paragraphs.zh: 一所没有边界的大学，卡内基梅隆大学通过覆盖欧洲、非洲、亚洲及其他地区的全球项目、合作伙伴关系与研究计划网络（包括位于卡塔尔和卢旺达的校区），将其影响力远远扩展到匹兹堡之外。 其社区包括来自100多个国家的学生、教师和校友，体现出深度的国际化视野。 卡内基梅隆大学的教师和校友中包括数十位诺贝尔奖和图灵奖得主，以及众多著名学术院成员和遍布全球业界、政界与艺术界的领袖人物。

paragraphs.en: Guided by a mission to have a transformative impact on society through education, research, creativity and entrepreneurship, Carnegie Mellon continues to shape emerging fields and prepare the next generation of innovators and leaders to address complex global challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 卡内基梅隆大学秉持通过教育、研究、创造与创业对社会产生变革性影响的使命，持续塑造新兴领域，并培养下一代创新者和领导者，以应对复杂的全球性挑战。

paragraphs.en: Ken Griffin is the founder and CEO of Citadel and the founder of Citadel Securities and Griffin Catalyst, the civic engagement initiative that encompasses his philanthropic and community impact efforts.
paragraphs.zh: Ken Griffin 是 Citadel 的创始人兼首席执行官，也是 Citadel Securities 和 Griffin Catalyst 的创始人，Griffin Catalyst 是一项公民参与计划，涵盖了他的慈善与社区影响力工作。

paragraphs.en: Ken founded Citadel in 1990, and today, it is recognized as one of the world’s most successful hedge funds. The Citadel team has delivered extraordinary results for pension plans, university endowments, hospital systems, foundations, and research institutions that deliver meaningful impact for society, from curing cancer with immunotherapy to making scientific breakthroughs in particle physics.
paragraphs.zh: Ken于1990年创立了Citadel，如今，它已被公认为全球最成功的对冲基金之一。 Citadel团队为养老基金、大学捐赠基金、医院系统、基金会以及研究机构创造了卓越的成果，这些机构为社会带来切实而有意义的影响，从利用免疫疗法治愈癌症到在粒子物理学领域取得科学突破。

paragraphs.en: In 2002, Ken and his partners established Citadel Securities, a leading global market maker. Today, it is one of the world’s largest liquidity providers, serving more than 1,600 institutional clients and millions of American families, and has proven transformative in enhancing competition in capital markets worldwide.
paragraphs.zh: 2002年，Ken与其合作伙伴共同创立了Citadel Securities，这是一家全球领先做市商。 如今，它已成为全球最大的流动性提供商之一，服务超过1600家机构客户和数百万美国家庭，并在提升全球资本市场竞争力方面发挥了变革性作用。

paragraphs.en: Ken is also a passionate philanthropist. Now advanced through Griffin Catalyst, Ken’s decades of philanthropy have expanded access to high-quality education for millions of Americans, transformed health care institutions and scientific research with historic gifts, and strengthened arts and cultural institutions around the world.
